item.tib: theg chen dam pa gsum gyi dmigs khrid gsal ba bdud rtsi'i gru char
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni snying nas byang chub don du gnyer ba'i gang zag las dang po la phan pa gtso bor byas pa'i dam pa gsum gyi dmigs khrid byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gnad tshang ba'i zhal gsal 'jug bde zhig cis kyang dgos zhes bal po'i yul nas byon pa'i bla ma kun spangs pa bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan dang rang slob dam pa bla ma g.yung drung tshul khrims sogs kyi thugs bzhed ngor theg chen gyi dge sbyor la mos pa tsam lam du byed pa'i slong (spong) ba pa khod spungs dbra ston bskal (skal) bzang bstan rgyal lam gzhan phan phrin las rgya mtsho zhes 'bod pas dben gnas byang chub gling gi nags mthong dben par dge sbyor gyi thun mtshams su sbyar ba'o//
